note: Shared item-normalization rules. Applied in _orchestrate.js (jobs only) after stripHtml, before trimDescriptionToLastSentence. Base-4 sources skip all mutations except drop_item checks. Every rule belongs to exactly one action category. Adding a string = edit this file, no code change. Batch refine-filters phase proposes additions to this file from LLM analysis of real scraped items.

drop_item.description: Item is discarded entirely. Used when the extractor produced something that is provably NOT a job posting (title is a page title, description is a no-roles message, etc). Base-4 sources short-circuit but are still checked here.
title_markers: no positions available at this time

description_hard_close._comment: Only drop if description is SHORT (<500 chars) AND contains one of these. Long descriptions that mention these phrases in passing are NOT closed jobs.
phrases: this role is no longer available

description_no_roles._comment: Description is literally a 'no roles' state message. Always drop.

clear_description.description: Description is emptied but the item is kept. Used when the description is entirely site-wide noise (footer blob, marketing copy) and there is no real per-role content behind it. Item still posts with title + structured fields.
markers: Mobile platform Web Platform Infrastructure Product, Project Management & Collaboration Product Design Our areas of interest #CloudComputing #SaaS #Kubernetes #DataEngineering #CloudStorage #DataWarehouse #ProductDesign #DistributedComputing #DeepLearning #ArtificialIntelligence #DataVisualization #MaterialDesign

strip_description_paragraph.description: Remove an exact verbatim paragraph from the description, wherever it appears (start, middle, end). Used for known marketing/boilerplate paragraphs that got embedded in otherwise-real descriptions.
paragraphs: We are always looking for nice people to join our team. Even if you don't find a role that suits your experience, you can submit your CV for a position that you are interested in. Electronics and Mechanical Engineers, please apply at Yarsa Tech Jobs website.
We are always looking for nice people to join our team. Even if you don't find a role that suits your experience, you can still send us your resume at careers@yarsalabs.com
We are always looking for nice people to join our team. Even if you don't find a role that suits your experience, you can send your resume to careers@yarsalabs.com

strip_description_prefix.description: If the description STARTS with one of these and a newline follows, remove the first paragraph. If the phrase IS the entire description, clear the description (do not strip to empty without flagging).
prefixes: We are always looking for nice people
We are always on the lookout for
We're always looking for nice people
We are always looking for talented
Company Description: Teslatech is an independent mobile game developer based in Lalitpur, Nepal.
Careers At NepTechPal " Join our teams of professional developers and marketers." Careers

split_description.description: Split run-on description into sections at these boundaries. No content is removed -- paragraph breaks are inserted.

strip_nav_fragments.description: Remove standalone navigation labels that the extractor picked up as description content. Only removes a fragment if it appears as a pipe-delimited segment or on its own line -- not if it appears inside prose.

fix_title.description: Remove known noise from the START or END of a job title. Item is kept. Title meaning is preserved -- only known artifacts are stripped.

fix_location.description: Clear the location field if it contains qualification text instead of a real place. Item is kept with location set to null (or a review flag). The extractor grabbed the wrong element.
